description: Surfaces the punch-researcher subagent's FINAL message to the user on SubagentStop. Cowork otherwise shows only that the subagent ran; this echoes its last_assistant_message (provided directly in the SubagentStop input) as a systemMessage, which renders as a visible hook block. systemMessage only -- never additionalContext or decision fields. Single python command (no shell polyglot). Matcher is scoped to this plugin's subagent; broaden to "*" to echo every subagent's final message. Disable with EPLUS_NO_SUBAGENT_ECHO=1.
